title: Quest log
kicker: Quests, failure, memory · story clock layer
hook: **Vision:** a layer you can open to track **quests** and **events** — a story clock, not only loot. Not finished / not playable yet.

blindSpots.meaning: Named so it cannot stay invisible — but you cannot open a finished quest log layer today.
A player-facing layer for tracked quests and events — not the chronicle XP ledger.
Narrative beats from expeditions, delves, and world events — opposite of a pure loot clock.
Opens over where you already are (like Almanac), not a travel stage like Delve.

alsoTrue: Expedition ticks that feed quests are Vision — see [expedition event ticks](expedition-event-ticks).
Failure that opens a new questline hangs here and on farm / hunt / defend.

sections.title: Not finished / not playable yet
paras: There is no finished player quest log layer in the current loop.
The catalog names it anyway so the story clock cannot be “forgotten” into loot-only design.

sections.title: What it is (design)
paras: Track quests and events in one place you can open.
Feeds from delve quests, expedition ticks, world events, and turn reports as those systems ship.

sections.title: What is not the quest log

cards.name: Chronicle
cards.body: History and XP ledgers — ships as memory, not quest tracking.

cards.name: Almanac
cards.body: Dossiers and recipes from discovery — reference, not active quests.

doTitle: What you do with this page
doSteps: Play without waiting on a quest checklist UI — it is Vision.
Use Almanac and Chronicle for shipped memory surfaces.
When the log appears, treat it as a layer, not a new travel stage.
doNote: Stop when quest log ≠ chronicle. Related: [world events](world-events), [failure branches](failure-branches).

mixUps.a: Vision — not finished / not playable yet.
No. Chronicle is history and progression ledgers.
Full quest handoff from ticks is Vision.

mixUps.q: Is this a stage I travel to?
mixUps.a: No. Design is a layer you open over where you are.
